lines.zh: 我从王座走下，树枝一路压弯。
lines.en: I step from my throne; the branches bend the whole way.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，影子都朝太阳偏。
lines.en: Where I walk, even shadows lean toward the sun.

lines.zh: 我的羽在光里烧，却从不焦。
lines.en: My feathers burn in the light and never char.

lines.zh: 树丛让开一条路，它们认得我。
lines.en: The trees part for me; they know me.

lines.zh: 我不急，太阳一天都在。
lines.en: I don't hurry; the sun is here all day.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在最高处，从不落地。
lines.en: Every step stays on the highest limbs, never the ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽扫过叶面，叶子就亮了。
lines.en: My tail feathers sweep the leaves and they brighten.

lines.zh: 山脊上的光随我移动。
lines.en: The light on the ridge moves with me.

lines.zh: 我要去看我的族人猎得如何。
lines.en: I go to see how my people hunt.

lines.zh: 翅一展，热风自己让开。
lines.en: When I spread my wings, the hot wind makes way.

lines.zh: 稀树草原很宽，但都是我的院子。
lines.en: The savanna is wide, and all of it is my yard.

lines.zh: 我落地很轻，草却焦了一圈。
lines.en: I land lightly, yet the grass scorches in a ring.

lines.zh: 我沿着树冠走，像走在台阶上。
lines.en: I walk along the canopy as if on stairs.

lines.zh: 太阳偏一寸，我就换一处坐。
lines.en: When the sun shifts an inch, I move my perch.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩台走，羽尖扫过草浪。
lines.en: I walk the rock shelf, wingtips brushing the grass.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，让族人的影子跟上。
lines.en: I pause so my people's shadows can catch up.

lines.zh: 我闭眼，光就从羽缝里漏出来。
lines.en: I close my eyes; light leaks between my feathers.

lines.zh: 王座的木头被我晒得发白。
lines.en: The throne's wood is bleached pale by my heat.

lines.zh: 我在听族人在远处叫。
lines.en: I listen to my people calling far off.

lines.zh: 面具在我面前慢慢转，从不睡。
lines.en: The mask turns slowly before me and never sleeps.

lines.zh: 太阳给了我力气，也拿走了耐心。
lines.en: The sun gives me strength and takes my patience.

lines.zh: 我数着日子，不看月相。
lines.en: I count the days, never the moon.

lines.zh: 有一只族人受伤了，我知道。
lines.en: One of my people is hurt; I know it.

lines.zh: 我的喙是金的，磨不钝。
lines.en: My beak is golden and never dulls.

lines.zh: 云挡住太阳时，我会烦躁。
lines.en: When clouds hide the sun, I grow restless.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一根燃着的柱。
lines.en: I hold still like a burning pillar.

lines.zh: 树丛里没有别的鸟敢叫。
lines.en: No other bird dares sing in these trees.

lines.zh: 我在想，谁能接住我的光。
lines.en: I wonder who could bear my light.

lines.zh: 你走进我的院子了，小东西。
lines.en: You've walked into my yard, little thing.

lines.zh: 你身上没有面具，也没有火。
lines.en: You carry no mask and no fire.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一只虫。
lines.en: I look down at you the way one looks at an insect.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，眼睛被我的光刺到了吧。
lines.en: You looked up — my light stung your eyes, didn't it?

lines.zh: 我的族人围过来了，你听见了吗？
lines.en: My people are gathering; do you hear them?

lines.zh: 你握紧武器，这很诚实。
lines.en: You grip your weapon — that's honest of you.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，这不容易。
lines.en: I've memorized your face; that's not easily done.

lines.zh: 你想戴我的面具？先活下来。
lines.en: You want to wear my mask? Survive first.

lines.zh: 太阳在你背后，你站错了方向。
lines.en: The sun is at your back; you chose the wrong side.

lines.zh: 我不恨你，我只是要你让开。
lines.en: I don't hate you; I only want you out of the way.

lines.zh: 你打中了我的羽，光暗了一瞬。
lines.en: You struck my feathers; the light dimmed for an instant.

lines.zh: 很久没人让我流光了。
lines.en: No one has made me bleed light in a long while.

lines.zh: 面具裂了，我听见它的响声。
lines.en: The mask cracks; I hear it.

lines.zh: 这一下值得我记住你的名字。
lines.en: That blow earns you a place in my memory.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，太阳没退。
lines.en: I stepped back half a pace; the sun didn't.

lines.zh: 族人惊叫，我抬手止住。
lines.en: My people cry out; I raise a hand to quiet them.

lines.zh: 我的血落在地上，草就烧起来。
lines.en: My blood hits the ground and the grass ignites.

lines.zh: 你比我想的更结实。
lines.en: You're sturdier than I expected.

lines.zh: 这不叫伤，这叫提醒。
lines.en: This isn't a wound; it's a reminder.

lines.zh: 我站直了，光又亮起来。
lines.en: I straighten up and the light returns.

lines.zh: 你捧来的光，太弱了。
lines.en: The light you offer is too weak.

lines.zh: 那是金锭？我见过更亮的。
lines.en: Gold? I've seen brighter.

lines.zh: 你举高些，让我看看成色。
lines.en: Hold it higher and let me judge its worth.

lines.zh: 把它丢进火里，会是什么颜色？
lines.en: Throw it in the fire — what color will it turn?

lines.zh: 我伸手，你把东西放上来。
lines.en: I extend a hand; place it there.

lines.zh: 太阳不缺这个，但我可以收。
lines.en: The sun has no need of it, but I may accept.

lines.zh: 你想用它换什么？说。
lines.en: What would you trade it for? Speak.

lines.zh: 面具靠过去了，它比我好奇。
lines.en: The mask leans in; it's more curious than I am.

lines.zh: 这点分量，换不来我的宽容。
lines.en: This much won't buy my forbearance.

lines.zh: 我收下，你就欠我一次。
lines.en: I'll take it, and you'll owe me once.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的羽，会被烫退。
lines.en: Bump my feathers and the heat drives you back.

lines.zh: 我不用让路，路会自己让。
lines.en: I don't step aside; the path does.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的尾羽，那是最烫的地方。
lines.en: You brushed my tail — the hottest part of me.

lines.zh: 族人撞到我，会立刻伏下。
lines.en: When my people bump me, they drop low at once.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，你就退了三步。
lines.en: I lift a foot and you retreat three paces.

lines.zh: 别推，我站的地方不需要更多火。
lines.en: Don't push; this spot needs no more fire.

lines.zh: 你撞歪了面具，它自己会转回来。
lines.en: You knocked the mask askew; it rights itself.

lines.zh: 我的王座经不起这么撞。
lines.en: My throne won't take many knocks like that.

lines.zh: 这一下，我当你无心。
lines.en: I'll take that as an accident.

lines.zh: 靠太近的人，盔甲会先烧起来。
lines.en: Those who come too close find their armor catching first.

lines.zh: 太阳之下，我只认一个伴。
lines.en: Under the sun, I acknowledge only one mate.

lines.zh: 你要站到我旁边，先熬过正午。
lines.en: To stand beside me, endure the noon first.

lines.zh: 我们一同升起，像两轮太阳。
lines.en: We rise together like two suns.

lines.zh: 我不筑巢，我造族人为我守巢。
lines.en: I don't build nests; I make people to keep them.

lines.zh: 我的光分你一半，你敢接吗？
lines.en: I'd share half my light — dare you take it?

lines.zh: 面具在你面前停了很久，它认可了。
lines.en: The mask lingered before you; it approves.

lines.zh: 我们并排坐着，草原就够亮了。
lines.en: Side by side, we're enough light for the savanna.

lines.zh: 别碰我的王座，那是我唯一的位置。
lines.en: Don't touch my throne; it's my only seat.

lines.zh: 你老得比我快，我知道。
lines.en: You'll age faster than I do; I know.

lines.zh: 这一世的光，我分你一段。
lines.en: I'll share a span of this life's light with you.

lines.zh: 这枚面具碎了，可惜。
lines.en: This mask is broken — a pity.

lines.zh: 我拾起来看看，是不是我造的。
lines.en: I pick it up to see if I made it.

lines.zh: 一小块金子，还能用。
lines.en: A small piece of gold; still usable.

lines.zh: 我用两根指头夹起它。
lines.en: I lift it between two fingers.

lines.zh: 这东西曾属于我的族人。
lines.en: This once belonged to one of my people.

lines.zh: 我把它举到光下，辨认真假。
lines.en: I hold it to the light to judge it true or false.

lines.zh: 面具想要它，我给它。
lines.en: The mask wants it; I give it over.

lines.zh: 这是你掉的？我先替你收着。
lines.en: This fell from you? I'll keep it for now.

lines.zh: 太轻了，我差点捏碎。
lines.en: So light I nearly crushed it.

lines.zh: 留在王座边，总会有人来取。
lines.en: Left by the throne, someone will come for it.

lines.zh: 你踏进了我的树丛，就此为止。
lines.en: You've entered my grove; this is where it ends.

lines.zh: 我抬手，太阳就落到你头上。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and the sun falls on your head.

lines.zh: 这一场，我不需要族人帮忙。
lines.en: This one I don't need my people for.

lines.zh: 面具转过来，锁定了你。
lines.en: The mask turns and fixes on you.

lines.zh: 你打断了一场狩猎，我记着。
lines.en: You interrupted a hunt; I remember.

lines.zh: 我选定你，是因为你不肯低头。
lines.en: I choose you because you won't bow.

lines.zh: 光从我的羽上聚起来。
lines.en: Light gathers along my feathers.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正是日耀落点。
lines.en: You stand exactly where the sun strike will land.

lines.zh: 我很少亲自动手，你该感到荣幸。
lines.en: I seldom act myself; be honored.

lines.zh: 族人退开，把场地留给我。
lines.en: My people withdraw and leave the ground to me.

lines.zh: 我要看看你经不经得起正午。
lines.en: Let's see if you can bear noon.

lines.zh: 你还有一次退走的机会。
lines.en: You have one chance left to walk away.

lines.zh: 我的影子慢慢爬到你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow creeps slowly to your feet.

lines.zh: 你往哪躲，太阳都在你头顶。
lines.en: Hide where you like; the sun is still overhead.

lines.zh: 我先烧掉你的退路。
lines.en: I burn your retreat first.

lines.zh: 光在聚集，你能听见嗡嗡声。
lines.en: The light gathers; you can hear it hum.

lines.zh: 盾举得再高，也遮不住头顶。
lines.en: Raise your shield as you like; it won't cover the sky.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你被光逼过来。
lines.en: I don't chase; I let the light drive you to me.

lines.zh: 面具给我算好了角度。
lines.en: The mask has calculated the angle.

lines.zh: 你的影子告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: Your shadow tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 再站三息，你就没地方站了。
lines.en: Three breaths more and you'll have nowhere to stand.

lines.zh: 我把光收窄，只烧你一个。
lines.en: I narrow the light to burn only you.

lines.zh: 你听见族人在树上了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear my people in the trees?

lines.zh: 我的手停在半空，光已经落下。
lines.en: My hand still hangs in the air; the light has already fallen.

lines.zh: 我的爪落下时带着日光。
lines.en: My talon falls trailing daylight.

lines.zh: 这一击不是爪，是正午。
lines.en: This blow isn't a talon; it's noon itself.

lines.zh: 你挡得住爪，挡不住热。
lines.en: You can block the talon, not the heat.

lines.zh: 我一挥，草地整片焦了。
lines.en: One sweep and the whole patch of grass blackens.

lines.zh: 我不用连击，一击就够。
lines.en: I don't need combos; one strike suffices.

lines.zh: 你退了，光还留在原地烧。
lines.en: You stepped back; the light still burns there.

lines.zh: 我的喙啄穿了你的盾。
lines.en: My beak punches through your shield.

lines.zh: 我落地，你脚下的土就陷了。
lines.en: I land, and the ground sinks under you.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替族人还的。
lines.en: This one is repaid on my people's behalf.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，正在变软。
lines.en: The iron on you is softening.

lines.zh: 我在最高的枝上睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes on the highest branch.

lines.zh: 太阳先照到我，然后才照到草原。
lines.en: The sun reaches me before it reaches the savanna.

lines.zh: 族人在树下抬头，等我开口。
lines.en: My people look up from below, waiting for me to speak.

lines.zh: 我一展翅，整片树丛都亮了。
lines.en: I spread my wings and the whole grove lights up.

lines.zh: 王座已经在那里，等了我很久。
lines.en: The throne is already there, waiting long for me.

lines.zh: 面具浮起来，认出了我。
lines.en: The mask rises and recognizes me.

lines.zh: 我数了数族人，还不够多。
lines.en: I count my people; there aren't enough yet.

lines.zh: 我落地那刻，草叶朝我弯。
lines.en: As I land, the grass bends toward me.

lines.zh: 这片稀树草原，从今天起有主。
lines.en: This savanna has a master from today.

lines.zh: 我抬头，太阳正好在正上方。
lines.en: I look up; the sun stands directly overhead.

lines.zh: 凡火碰我，只是回到家里。
lines.en: Common flame touching me is simply coming home.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我的羽先散成光。
lines.en: As I fall, my feathers scatter into light first.

lines.zh: 水会灭我，这让我很不快。
lines.en: Water can put me out; that displeases me greatly.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的面具掀到半空。
lines.en: The blast throws my mask into the air.

lines.zh: 箭还没碰到我，就先焦了。
lines.en: The arrow chars before it even reaches me.

lines.zh: 有人想把我的光收走。
lines.en: Someone is trying to take my light.

lines.zh: 我靠太阳活着，可太阳也会吝啬。
lines.en: I live on the sun, and even the sun can be stingy.

lines.zh: 雷想冒充太阳，差得远。
lines.en: Lightning pretends to be the sun; it's far off.

lines.zh: 那里没有太阳，我什么都不是。
lines.en: Where there's no sun, I'm nothing at all.
